To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the RAB can be used in pavement construction with the use of the rejuvenators, softer bitumen or the WPMB as a modifier to improve its performance.
the chemical and physical rheology of RAB containing mixes can be improved by the use of the rejuvenator, the softer bitumen and WPMB.
softer bitumen, the WPMB and the rejuvenator improved chemical structure and physical rheological properties of the RAP binder mixes, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of modifiers on physical rheological and colloidal properties of RAB containing binders.
the effects of different modifiers on chemical and physical rheology properties of the RAP binder mixes.
the application of different modifiers in the chemical and physical rheology of the RAB binder mixes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the rejuvenator had the greatest effect in improving the physical rheological parameters, chemical structure and colloidal properties of RAB containing mixes in comparison with other modifiers.
softer bitumen and rejuvenator are more effective than the WPMB in improvement of the chemical and physical rheology properties of RAB containing bitumen mixes.
the WPMB is an efficient and effective alternative for rejuvenating of RAB containing bituminous mixes in comparison with the rejuvenator and the softer bitumen.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the rejuvenator, soft bitumen and the waste polymer bitumen could be used to improve physical rheological and the chemical properties of RAB containing binders.
the WPMB could be used as a good alternative of the rejuvenator in the case of the RAB content of 30% in the binder mixes.

the WPMB is the best modifier for the RAB containing asphalt binder mixes, because it has the best effects on chemical and physical rheologies of the binder mixes, and also it can be used in the asphalt binder production process as a waste product.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chemical structure of the binder mixes can be improved by the addition of different modifiers.
RAB containing binder mix can be modified by the softer bitumen or the WPMB to the level of virgin asphalt binder in terms of chemical and physical rheology properties.
RAP materials can be reused in asphalt mixtures with the help of different modifiers such as rejuvenator, softer binder and the WPMB.
